qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (in_market == 'N', REJECT). Primary listing on Warsaw Stock Exchange (Poland) fails the developed Western market rule-of-law pre-screen. Highly exposed to Polish public sector procurement and fragmented CEE IT services.
qualitative.evidence: Pre-screen listing jurisdiction is Poland (in_market == 'N'). While Asseco provides sticky proprietary banking and public sector systems across CEE, low operating margins (~10%) and heavy reliance on competitive public procurement tenders combine with non-Western market pre-screen exclusion to require immediate rejection at Gate 2.
